Export!C2:C13 are formula-only cells without cached values; sandbox read of the workbook showed each formula as "='Counts'!Bn*'Pack factors'!Bn" (n=2..13), i.e. Stock pieces = Cartons x Pieces per carton.
SKU joins Export<->Counts and Export<->Pack factors are 1:1 over all 12 rows with zero unmatched keys (trim_upper, leading zeros preserved).
SKU cells A2:A13 read as text '000001'..'000012' (six characters, leading zeros), so qty inputs and identity keep original form.
Header 'SKU' in Export A1; values A2:A13 read as text '000001'..'000012'.
Target requires the identifier as string with leading zeros preserved; normalization only trims/compacts whitespace.
Header 'Product name' in Export B1; 12 distinct non-null values ('Coffee variant 01', ...).
Target description: product name from the master list; Export is the master product sheet.
Export!C2:C13 formulas are "='Counts'!Bn*'Pack factors'!Bn" (verified in the workbook formula text, rows 2..13).
Export column C has no cached results, so qty is reproduced exactly from its two verified operands rather than read from C.
Counts!B ('Cartons', integers 3..14) and Pack factors!B ('Pieces per carton', 12/24/6) join 1:1 to Export on SKU with zero unmatched rows.
Target /qty is stock in individual pieces; cartons x pieces per carton yields pieces, e.g. SKU 000001 = 3 x 12 = 36.
